excerpt.en: Despite the planet's lack of atmosphere, there is evidence of some kind of artificial structures on [From.GetName] that may indicate a past civilization.

scope.zh: 异常与同星系卫星殖民后的超级耀斑链全部核对。
scope.en: Anomaly and the superflare chain after colonising the moon in the same system fully checked.

label.zh: 殖民星系内受辐照的卫星后（360–410天）
label.en: After colonising the irradiated moon in this system (360–410 days)

note.zh: SUPERFLARE_PROJECT 限时150天：完成为 distar.9，失败为 distar.10。
note.en: SUPERFLARE_PROJECT has a 150-day time limit: success distar.9, failure distar.10.

texts.zh: 虽然[From.GetName]这颗星球上缺乏大气，但地表上有人造设施的遗迹，说明过去这里曾有文明。
texts.en: Despite the planet's lack of atmosphere, there is evidence of some kind of artificial structures on [From.GetName] that may indicate a past civilization.

sections.zh: 虽然[From.GetName]这颗星球上缺乏大气，但地表上有人造设施的遗迹，说明过去这里曾有文明。
sections.en: Despite the planet's lack of atmosphere, there is evidence of some kind of artificial structures on [From.GetName] that may indicate a past civilization.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]上的船员十分兴奋的发现在[From.GetName]上有工业时代文明的遗迹。调查表明[From.GetName]在过去的数百万年里一直维持着大气层，直到恒星[From.GetStarName]那不稳定的表面所发出的超强耀斑导致了行星大气层的失控电离化逃逸和耗散。

在失去大气层之后数千年间，[From.GetName]上那些了无生机的城市都被封冻于时间长河之中。这是纪念发生于此处大灭绝的无声纪念碑。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]警告任何在[From.GetStarName]星系的殖民都可能受制于恒星无常的暴怒。
texts.en:
The crew of the [Root.GetName] were intrigued to find the remnants of an industrial-age civilization on [From.GetName]. Investigation indicates [From.GetName] had sustained an atmosphere for millions of years, until massive superflares from the unstable surface of the star [From.GetStarName] led to runaway ionization and depletion of the planet's atmospheric gases.

With no atmosphere, the lifeless cities on [From.GetName] have been frozen in time for millennia, silent monuments to the mass extinction that happened there.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] cautions that any colonies in the [From.GetStarName] system may be subject to the whims of the star's turbulence.

label.zh: 殖民星系内受辐照的卫星后（360–410天）
label.en: After colonising the irradiated moon in this system (360–410 days)

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]上的传感器发现[Root.GetStarName]表面正呈现出在超强耀斑出现之前所特有的动荡现象。考虑到[frozen_in_time_planet.GetName]远古文明的命运，我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]正在争分夺秒设计一个护盾矩阵来抵挡即将到来的巨量等离子喷发。
texts.en: Sensors on [Root.GetName] indicate that [Root.GetStarName] is exhibiting surface turbulence typical to that preceding a superflare. Considering the fate of the ancient civilization on [frozen_in_time_planet.GetName], our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] are scrambling to devise a shield matrix capable of withstanding the impending enormous plasma ejection.

texts.zh:
传感器发现[Root.GetStarName]的亮度达出现了一次激增。看来该恒星正在产生超强耀斑，这和当初摧毁了[frozen_in_time_planet.GetName]文明的超强耀斑基本一致。

万幸的是，没有[Root.GetAdj]殖民地会被这场恒星暴动波及。
texts.en:
Sensors have registered a massive spike in [Root.GetStarName]'s luminosity. It appears the star is experiencing a superflare, not unlike the one that destroyed the civilization on [frozen_in_time_planet.GetName].

Fortunately for us, however, there are no [Root.GetAdj] colonies that will be affected by this solar turbulence.

label.zh: 我们必须保护我们的人民！

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]上的传感器表明[From.GetStarName]正准备喷发另一场超强耀斑，正如摧毁了[From.From.GetName]上的远古文明那次一样。我们必须在此之前寻找方法保护我们的殖民地。
texts.en: Sensors on [Root.GetName] indicate that [From.GetStarName] is preparing for another superflare event, not unlike the one that destroyed the ancient civilization on [From.From.GetName]. We need to find a way to shield our colony before the flare erupts.

texts.zh: 行星管理部门很高兴汇报到在[Root.GetName]周围建立的超强耀斑护盾矩阵非常成功，我们的殖民者不但可以安全避开有害的等离子辐射，还享受到了太阳风击打在全新的护盾矩阵上产生的炫目多彩的极光盛宴。
texts.en: Planetary administration is pleased to report that the development of a superflare shield matrix around [Root.GetName] was a complete success. Our colonists were not only safely shielded from the harmful ionizing radiation, but were treated to a spectacular auroral display as solar wind interacted with the new shield matrix.

note.zh: 殖民地获得 superflare_avoided，科学家获得经验与专长。
note.en: Colony gains superflare_avoided; the scientist gains experience and an expertise.

texts.zh:
来自[fromfromfrom.GetStarName]的超强耀斑轰击了[fromfromfrom.GetName]的上层大气，我们没能及时布置起防护超强耀斑的护盾矩阵。

等离子喷流和磁场风暴导致了整个行星范围内的电子干扰，妨碍了能源产出并裹挟着辐射冲击了人民。这一灾难性后果还将持续一段时间。
texts.en:
A superflare from [fromfromfrom.GetStarName] has struck the upper atmosphere of [fromfromfrom.GetName], pending our failure to develop an appropriate shield matrix in time.

Ionizing plasma and magnetic storms have led to electronic disruptions planetside, interfering with energy production and blasting the populace with radiation. The effects will persist for some time.

note.en: 20 years of superflare_struck and one pop killed.

summary.text:
# 超强耀斑 / Superflare

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration · DLC：《遥远繁星》Distant Stars（has_distar） · 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-12（已审阅 reviewed）
- 来源 Sources：common/solar_system_initializers/distant_stars_initializers.txt:1740-1827 (superflare_system); common/anomalies/95_anomaly_categories_distant_stars.txt:30-42; events/distant_stars_events_1.txt:213-390 (distar.5-10); common/special_projects/00_projects_distant_stars.txt:4-31 (SUPERFLARE_PROJECT); common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1301

## 如何开始 How it starts

《遥远繁星》专属星系 superflare_system（G型恒星，至多一个）中，一颗冰冻星球带有“文明的遗踪”异常（1级），同一星系的气态巨行星有一颗带 superflare_planet 修正的核爆卫星。调查异常得到 distar.6；殖民那颗卫星则开始耀斑事件。

In the Distant Stars system superflare_system (G star, at most one) a frozen planet carries the level-1 anomaly "Traces of Civilization", and a gas giant has a nuked moon with the superflare_planet modifier. Investigating the anomaly gives distar.6; colonising the moon starts the flare events.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

1. distar.6“在时光中冻结”：工业时代文明因恒星超级耀斑失去大气而灭绝，科学官提醒本星系殖民地可能受恒星影响；星球获得社会学矿藏。
2. 殖民核爆卫星后，隐藏的 distar.5 排定360–410天后的 distar.7“超强耀斑”。
3. 若此时仍有殖民地（或正在殖民），可开启 SUPERFLARE_PROJECT（30天，科研船+科学家，限时150天）；否则只能接受，星球得到20年 superflare_struck。
4. 项目成功 → distar.9；超时失败 → distar.10。若接受项目后失去殖民地，隐藏 distar.8 直接施加耀斑效果。

1. distar.6 "Frozen in Time": an industrial-age civilisation died when superflares stripped its atmosphere; the science officer warns that colonies in this system may suffer the same; the planet gains a society deposit.
2. Colonising the nuked moon makes the hidden distar.5 schedule distar.7 "Superflare" 360–410 days later.
3. If the colony still exists (or is being founded) the player can start SUPERFLARE_PROJECT (30 days, science ship + scientist, 150-day limit); otherwise the planet simply gets 20 years of superflare_struck.
4. Success → distar.9; time-out → distar.10. If the colony is lost after accepting, the hidden distar.8 applies the flare effects.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

distar.7 的两个选项按是否有殖民地互斥；项目结果 distar.9 / distar.10 互斥。

distar.7's two options are exclusive by colony state; project results distar.9 / distar.10 are exclusive.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

distar.7 有两段文本：有殖民地时描述紧急研制护盾，无殖民地时说明没有殖民地受影响。

distar.7 has two texts: with a colony it describes the emergency shield, without one it notes no colony is affected.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

已核对初始化、异常、distar.5–10、项目和 on_colonized。修正：草稿把异常（2篇）和耀斑殖民链（4篇）拆成两个故事；现合并，并用审阅连接表示“殖民卫星后”。耀斑链不要求先调查异常，但 distar.7 文本引用了本异常的冰冻星球。

Checked initializer, anomaly, distar.5–10, the project and on_colonized. Correction: the draft split the anomaly (2 docs) and the flare chain (4 docs); merged with a reviewed "after colonising the moon" link. The flare chain does not require the anomaly, but distar.7 refers to this anomaly's frozen planet.
